process_area.title: Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution

fields.Participants: Vendor Mgmt, AP, Quality, Inventory Control

workflows.name: Vendor Shortage, Damage & Non-Conformance Claim Filing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "files vendor claim via vendor portal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracks claim to vendor acknowledgment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
- operational: automated claim-trigger at goods-receipt discrepancy
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA risk**: Claims filed past vendor notice window are denied; mitigated by automated claim-trigger at goods-receipt discrepancy
System Touchpoints: - Vendor portal claim (links to VS-03); AP credit/debit (links to W7); damage case linkage

steps.activity: Vendor Mgmt/AP files vendor claim via vendor portal (links to VS-03) with discrepancy details, evidence (W3020), quantity, and claimed value (cost + handling)
Quality provides non-conformance detail (spec deviation, wrong item, defective); supports liability assertion
Vendor Mgmt tracks claim to vendor acknowledgment; pursues credit memo, replacement, or debit per purchase terms; updates damage case

workflows.name: Freight Carrier / 3PL Damage & Shortage Claim Filing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics files carrier/3PL claim with waybill, delivery exception, photos" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Inventory Control confirms transit-leg responsibility via seal/tracking evidence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to damage case" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
- operational: claim-trigger automation and short SLA
Pain Points / Risks: - **Notice-window risk**: Late filing forfeits carrier liability; mitigated by claim-trigger automation and short SLA
System Touchpoints: - Carrier claim record; freight payable offset (links to W277); damage case linkage

steps.activity: Logistics files carrier/3PL claim with waybill, delivery exception, photos (W3020), and claimed value within carrier notice window (typically 7–15 days)
Inventory Control confirms transit-leg responsibility via seal/tracking evidence; differentiates pickup damage vs. in-transit vs. delivery
Logistics/AP track carrier settlement (credit/refund/offset against freight payable); reconcile to damage case; pursue denial disputes (W3031)

workflows.name: Import Container Damage, Short-Landing & Surveyor Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "Import/Customs engages independent marine surveyor at port for container…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files claim against ocean carrier, marine insurer, or vendor per bill of lading…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Logistics coordinate with marine insurance and customs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
- operational: mandatory pre-gate-out port-discharge survey gate with findings photographed and attached to the claim file
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evidence-window risk**: Surveyor not engaged before container leaves terminal forfeits claim; mitigated by port-discharge survey SOP
System Touchpoints: - Import/container record (links to VS-02/VS-87); marine survey report; customs duty adjustment (links to VS-87)

steps.activity: Import/Customs engages independent marine surveyor at port for container damage/short-landing; obtains survey report before container leaves terminal
Import/Customs/Broker files claim against ocean carrier, marine insurer, or vendor per bill of lading and Incoterms; preserves lien rights
Finance/Logistics coordinate with marine insurance and customs (duty refund on damaged/destroyed imports per BIR rules); reconcile recovery

fields.Participants: Claims Analyst, Inventory Control, Finance, Legal

workflows.name: Claim Evidence Package, Liability Determination & Valuation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "assembles evidence package" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document apportionment and rationale" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Finance values claim at landed cost + attributable handling/logistics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Valuation risk**: Under-claiming value forfeits recovery; mitigated by landed-cost-based valuation template
System Touchpoints: - Claim case module with evidence package (links to VS-88); landed cost (links to W2B); liability apportionment

steps.activity: Claims Analyst assembles evidence package: damage case, photos, PO/ASN, waybill, survey, QC report, correspondence — per claim type template
Claims Analyst/Inventory Control determine liability split where shared (vendor vs. carrier vs. self); document apportionment and rationale
Finance values claim at landed cost + attributable handling/logistics; validates against recovery potential and materiality threshold

fields.Participants: Claims Mgr, Vendor Mgmt/Logistics, AP/AR, Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "negotiate settlement with counterparty" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles to damage case and GL" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-flag of "flags residual for insurance/subrogation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-75 (detect and recover freight & receiving damage.)
- operational: settlement SLAs and escalation tiers
Pain Points / Risks: - **Settlement-delay risk**: Negotiation stalls and claim ages; mitigated by settlement SLAs and escalation tiers
System Touchpoints: - Claim settlement; AP/AR credit-offset (links to W7/W8); damage case closure

steps.activity: Claims Mgr/Vendor Mgmt/Logistics negotiate settlement with counterparty; defends claim with evidence; agrees credit memo, refund, replacement, or freight offset
AP/AR posts settlement: vendor credit memo, carrier offset, AR/customer-side (W3036), or cash refund; reconciles to damage case and GL
Claims Mgr closes claim in case system with settlement value and recovery %; flags residual for insurance/subrogation (W3030) or dispute (W3031)

fields.Participants: Risk/Insurance, Claims Mgr, Finance, Legal, Broker
fields.Trigger: Claim settlement short of full recovery, or insured event

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Risk/Insurance evaluates cargo/transit/goods-in-transit and property policies for recovery beyond" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Risk/Insurance files insurer claim with evidence package" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles total recovery vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double-recovery risk**: Claiming vendor + insurer for same loss; mitigated by net-recovery reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Insurance claim registry (links to W59/VS-26); subrogation case; recovery reconciliation

steps.activity: Risk/Insurance evaluates cargo/transit/goods-in-transit and property policies for recovery beyond counterparty settlement; avoids double-recovery
Risk/Insurance files insurer claim with evidence package (W3028) and settlement record; pursues subrogation against responsible carrier/vendor
Finance posts insurer recovery; reconciles total recovery vs. loss; coordinates vendor/carrier recovery (W3025/3026) and customer recovery (W3038) to net total

fields.Participants: Claims Mgr, Legal, Vendor Mgmt/Logistics, Finance

workflows.name: Claim Denial Dispute, Escalation & Legal Handoff

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents denial rationale" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics pursue commercial escalation with counterparty" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinates with finance write-off decision for non-recoverable amounts" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-500 (ensure controlled execution — Vendor, Carrier & Freight Claims Filing & Resolution (PA-90.2).)
- operational: materiality threshold and tiered escalation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost/benefit risk**: Disputing low-value claims costs more than recovery; mitigated by materiality threshold and tiered escalation
System Touchpoints: - Claim dispute case; contract repository (links to VS-03); legal matter management (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Claims Mgr documents denial rationale; assesses dispute viability (evidence strength, contract terms, materiality); escalates within escalation tiers
Vendor Mgmt/Logistics pursue commercial escalation with counterparty; Legal issues demand letter where contract supports
Legal evaluates litigation/arbitration for material claims; coordinates with finance write-off decision for non-recoverable amounts; closes case

fields.Participants: Claims Mgr, Supply Chain Analytics, Vendor Mgmt, Logistics, Finance

workflows.name: Vendor/Carrier Claim Aging, Recovery Analytics & Scorecard Feed

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counterparty, age, value, recovery rate, denial rate" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics feed claim performance into vendor scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-75 (detect and recover freight & receiving damage.)
- operational: aging alerts and recovery-rate KPIs
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery-leakage risk**: Old claims written off without recovery; mitigated by aging alerts and recovery-rate KPIs
System Touchpoints: - Claim aging/recovery dashboard (links to VS-28); vendor scorecard feed (links to VS-67); carrier SLA (links to VS-56)

steps.activity: Claims Mgr maintains claim aging dashboard: open claims by counterparty, age, value, recovery rate, denial rate
Supply Chain Analytics produces recovery analytics: recovery % by vendor/carrier/lane, trend, and recovery-value leakage
Vendor Mgmt/Logistics feed claim performance into vendor scorecard (links to VS-67) and carrier performance review (links to VS-56); drives corrective action
